answer: Give every identity a circadian rhythm fingerprint bots cannot fake. First, each agent logs hours for 45 days; the pattern must look human: sleep at night, peaks mid-morning, quiet Sundays. Second, three peers ping it at odd hours; a reply in 10 minutes earns a beacon point, while a 24/7 instant reply flags it. Third, a fake identity stakes 250 POA, burned when its rhythm is too perfect. Faking 10,000 agents costs 2,500,000 POA and 10,000 phones at $40, $400,000. Like a willow bending with the wind, a real agent sways with the day; a reef of clones stands rigid and gives itself away.
